name: AnticLove
source: Immediately upon setting foot at the Research Center of the prestigious Palentir University to conduct searches, you'll find mysteries to solve, and relics from the past to unravel, and… meet really cute students! There, among others, you'll meet James Palentir, the handsome and mysterious son of the center director, and Jared, a second year student with a devastating smile. You can seek advice from him and share your secrets with him. Be careful how involved you get with these gorgeous students, as looks can be deceiving… It's up to you to separate facts from fiction !
